text:
Aisha (CS): MapleFrame renewal question — they want to do a 50% deposit now and the remainder Net30. They also need SSO/MFA onboarding completed before billing goes live. Legal flagged a signer delegation change (parent company signing). Who can confirm we can accept split deposit + e-sign flow? cc @Tom (Finance) @Priya (Legal) @Sam (Onboarding)
Ben (AE): They're fine with us invoicing the remainder Net30. Want invoice to be billed to MapleFrame Holdings (tax id 12-3456789). Can we map the billing entity without a formal amendment?
Priya (Legal): If the parent entity signs, we need evidence of authority. Either a board resolution or POA. Is the current SOW tied to the subsidiary or the holding co?
Tom (Finance): We can accept 50% upfront via card or wire; balance invoiced Net30 to the holding company. Need legal confirmation on signer + remit-to entity before we will issue the invoice. contracts-bot please create billing change request.
contracts-bot: Created billing_change_request #BCR-4021 for MapleFrame, assigned to @Tom (Finance). ETA 2 business days.
Sam (Onboarding): MFA/SSO onboarding is currently blocked by their security team until we have an acknowledged MSA with the delegated signer recorded. If they can provide a POA (PDF) we can pre-provision. Otherwise we can offer limited sandbox access only.
Priya (Legal): If MapleFrame Holdings signs the MSA, we need either: 1) Board resolution, or 2) POA. A notarized POA via DocuSign is acceptable if their legal ops can provide it.
Aisha (CS): Proposed next steps: 1) Ben to request POA from customer, 2) Tom to accept card or wire for the 50% deposit, 3) Priya to review the returned POA, 4) contracts-bot to update billing entity once POA confirmed, 5) Sam to prep SSO/MFA provisioning for immediate kickoff once POA is validated. Anyone disagree? :raised_hands:
Ben (AE): I'll request POA and confirm if they prefer card vs wire. Also will confirm the tax id. Draft message I will send: `Can you provide a POA authorizing MapleFrame Holdings to sign commercial agreements on behalf of MapleFrame LLC, plus remit-to details for invoicing?`
Tom (Finance): If they wire, please include invoice reference in the payment description. For card payments, send billing contact and last4 for quick processing. We'll hold full onboarding until legal sign-off, but can provide temporary sandbox access.
Aisha (CS): I'll draft an internal email template and paste it here for Ben to forward. If POA arrives by EOD Thursday we can provision MFA SSO next week and schedule kickoff. If not, offer sandbox access only.
Priya (Legal): I'll fast-track POA review once it's attached. Note: if the POA omits specific signing rights or is redacted, I will ask for clarifying documentation. Also may need to surface an indemnity/third-party clause if the signatory is not the operating entity.
Ben (AE): Customer replied in-thread: "We can provide a notarized POA by tomorrow, and we prefer to wire the deposit." I'll post payment confirmation once they send remittance.
Aisha (CS): Tracking summary: BCR-4021 created, POA pending, deposit pending. I'll update when payment clears and when legal confirms. :white_check_mark:
